subject: how to add lines to a plot? (newbie question)

messages.author: 20a857807016d58a
messages.subject: how to add lines to a plot? (newbie question)
parts:
Dear expeRts,

I would like to add lines to an existing plot with three groups. For
each group,
I would like to add one line sharing the same group color. This is
certainly a
newbie question, but I had troubles working with geom_line and I
couldn't find a
solution. Here's the code:

library(ggplot2)
set.seed(1)

df <- data.frame(x=rep(2000:2011, 3), group=rep(c("low", "middle",
"high"), each=12),
y=df$x+100*runif(3*12))

means <- aggregate(df[,"y"], by=list(group=df$group), mean)
colnames(means)[2] <- "mean"

qplot(x, y, data=df, color=group, geom="line") + geom_line(data=means,
aes(group=group))

My questions are:
(1) how can I use geom_line with a different data frame than the one
used by qplot?
I know I could create a larger data frame, just adding the value
of the means
to df and plot then. But I am particularly interested in using
different data frames
(2) how can I obtain the same group colors as in qplot?

Cheers,

Marius

Hi,

apparently my minimal example did not work. Here is a new one
(including the "solution" addressed in (1)):

geom_line(data=means.df.)


okay, so I guess the color is taken care of by "+"...
